capabilities: Render Linked Quran surah pages as verse cards with your note, translation tabs and a Publish button
Sync published verse notes both ways with your linkedquran.com account, including drafts and site edits
Set up all 114 missing surahs from the site and refresh Arabic, word-by-word and translations
Toggle the site's public study layers under each verse and act on them with a sync key
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer; every network request goes to the site in the settings and the README includes a full request table and privacy policy link; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; no account key limits the plugin to drawing public layers on existing surah pages.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read the Quran verse by verse with personal notes, translations and the site's study layers inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Notes you publish sync with your account on the site; drafts you write in the vault stay there.

summary: Quran study companion that renders linkedquran.com surah pages as verse cards in the vault and syncs published verse notes with the site.
